// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-CHILD-RELATION
// The permitted traversal with a class name smuggled in beside it. A prefix
// match would have let this through and it is a per-class count in disguise,
// which is why the permission requires the whole object to be the traversal.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function pupilsOnRoll(schoolId, className) {
  return db.student.count({
    where: { class: { teacher: { schoolId }, name: className } },
  });
}
